205729|2fb0f637.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|2fb0f637.text:
Most impressive that you have noticed me, $r. You may have a talent for the shadows.

I am Boarton Shadetotem, a master of the arts of stealth and subtlety. You may find the idea of a $r rogue implausible, even impossible. For many years I took pride that my skills were mine alone. But I have seen my people face unimaginable challenges, and I now feel a duty to share my knowledge with the tribe.

3084|de5042ab.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|de5042ab.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

76156-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-accept.text: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, $c. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76156-complete.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-complete.text: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
76156-complete.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76156-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-progress.text: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $c. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-accept.text: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-complete.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-complete.text:
This is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions?

This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.
76160-complete.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-progress.text: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, $c. Even skin contact could be quite painful.
76160-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76240-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76240-accept.text:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

861-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
861-progress.text: Greetings.  There is an air about you that tells me much.  Do we have business, you and I?
861-progress.title: The Hunter's Way

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

96605-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96605-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96659-complete.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-complete.text:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659-complete.title: The Adventurer

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

96661-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96661-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96661-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97934-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97934-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97934-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98427-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98427-accept.text:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

$N, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427-accept.title: Ceasing Operations

98430-accept.name: Perith Stormhoof
98430-accept.text:
Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430-accept.title: The Longwalkers

98430-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
98430-complete.text:
I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.

Please, accept my thanks and my hospitality for risking your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.

I encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.

Ish-ne-alo por-ah.
98430-complete.title: The Longwalkers

99080-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-complete.text:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $c.
99080-complete.title: Drive Them Out

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99411-accept.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-accept.text:
Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411-accept.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!

99411-complete.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411-complete.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
